issue.title: Trunk LAG interface is listed as routed port in "show interfaces status" output.

failure.body:
#### Description
A trunk LAG port is listed as router port in show interfaces status output

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. add random vlans
2. create a portchannel
3. add ports to portchannel
4. assign vlans to portchannel
5. issue show interface status

#### Describe the results you received:
`
#show int status | grep -iE "(Ethernet0|Ethernet8|portcha)"

      Ethernet0          0,1,2,3       1G   9100    N/A     etp1  PortChannel0001      up       up   QSFP+ or later         N/A
      Ethernet8        8,9,10,11      1G   9100    N/A     etp3  PortChannel0001      up       up  QSFP28 or later         N/A
      PortChannel0001   N/A           2G   9100    N/A      N/A           routed    down       up              N/A         N/A
`

#### Describe the results you expected:
A trunk LAG port should be listed as **trunk** port in show interfaces status' output

#### Output of `show version`:
```
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.SONIC.202012.25-7c00106_Internal
Distribution: Debian 10.8
Kernel: 4.19.0-12-2-amd64
Build commit: 7c001068
Build date: Tue Feb 23 <IPV6> UTC 2021
Built by: sw-r2d2-bot@r-build-sonic-ci02

Platform: x86_64-mlnx_msn3800-r0
HwSKU: ACS-MSN3800
```

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
[sonic_dump_r-qa-sw-eth-2322_20210301_124956.tar.gz](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/6061704/sonic_dump_r-qa-sw-eth-2322_20210301_124956.tar.gz)

resolution.title: [show] Fix int status of LAGs, configured as Vlan members
resolution.description:
Pass missed argument to function "appl_db_portchannel_status_get" in "intfutil" script to provide correct information in "Vlan" column of command "show int status" for LAG interfaces.

Signed-off-by: Maksym Belei <<EMAIL>>

#### What I did
Resolves https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6928
Fixed status of LAG interfaces in Vlan column. LAG interfaces, configured as a Vlan member, should be seen as trunk interface.

#### How I did it
Missed argument "self.combined_int_to_vlan_po_dict" passed to function "appl_db_portchannel_status_get"
  in "intfutil" script.

#### How to verify it
```
admin@sonic:~$ show int status | grep PortChannel0011
      Ethernet4          4,5,6,7      N/A   9100    N/A     etp2  PortChannel0011    down       up             N/A         N/A
      Ethernet8        8,9,10,11      N/A   9100    N/A     etp3  PortChannel0011      up       up  QSFP+ or later         N/A
PortChannel0011              N/A        G   9100    N/A      N/A           routed    down       up             N/A         N/A
admin@sonic:~$ sudo config vlan member add 11 PortChannel0011
admin@sonic:~$ show vlan brief | grep 11
|        11 |              | PortChannel0011 | tagged         |                       | disabled    |
admin@sonic:~$ show int status | grep PortChannel0011
      Ethernet4          4,5,6,7      N/A   9100    N/A     etp2  PortChannel0011    down       up             N/A         N/A
      Ethernet8        8,9,10,11      N/A   9100    N/A     etp3  PortChannel0011      up       up  QSFP+ or later         N/A
PortChannel0011              N/A        G   9100    N/A      N/A            trunk    down       up             N/A         N/A
admin@sonic:~$ sudo config vlan member del 11 PortChannel0011
admin@sonic:~$ show vlan brief | grep 11
|        11 |              |         |                |                       | disabled    |
admin@sonic:~$ show int status | grep PortChannel0011
      Ethernet4          4,5,6,7      N/A   9100    N/A     etp2  PortChannel0011    down       up             N/A         N/A
      Ethernet8        8,9,10,11      N/A   9100    N/A     etp3  PortChannel0011      up       up  QSFP+ or later         N/A
PortChannel0011              N/A        G   9100    N/A      N/A           routed    down       up             N/A         N/A
```
